evidence.title: AI-based worker guidance in assembly and disassembly operations using multimodal ego/exo-centric data capture and structured task knowledge

summary: A new AI system leverages multimodal ego- and exo-centric data capture combined with structured task knowledge to guide workers in complex assembly and disassembly operations. The approach aims to improve efficiency and accuracy in industrial workflows.
title: AI Enhances Worker Guidance in Assembly and Disassembly Using Multimodal Data
